Use this app to manage and control your Smart Shower. You will be able to establish your own parameters and use all its functions:
Warm up: Pre-heat the shower at the desired temperature by activating all its water outlets at once.
Child mode: Block the temperature, the water flow and water outlets for the safety of the little ones.
My program: Customize your shower experience by managing the water temperature and outlets you prefer any time during the day.
Bath filling: Fill up your bath at the desired temperature using cold water at the start to avoid the unnecessary use of energy. The filling will automatically stop once the volume of water has reached the maximum pre-set level.
 
Other maintenance functions available are:
Disinfection:  It activates all water outlets at the maximum temperature for total disinfection.
Cleaning: It Activate water shocks at high pressure to remove lime and impurities from the outlets and the pipes.

The app allows you to set up all these options with up to 3 different user profiles. Moreover, you can also check your water and energy consumption and their statistics, the history of warnings and general information on the product.
